title: Settlement
$comment: OBSERVED object (§5.1): nobody authors it; this schema describes rather than constrains. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

txRef.description: The settlement reference: the transfer that affixed the envelope’s stamps (§4.3).

from.description: The sender’s account. The fourth weld: the sender of an envelope is this account (§7.2, D-64).

amount.description: Stamps affixed. Counts only if it covers weight + (rr ? 1 : 0) (§4.2, §7.5).

memo.description: "wishmail:" + aadHash (§4.3). A settlement whose memo is not this is, for that envelope, no settlement (§8.5).

consensusTimestamp.description: Must precede chunk 0’s or the envelope is unstamped (§8.5, §8.6).
